title: The Apostles' Creed
subtitle: The received form

sections.label: Article 1
paragraphs: I believe in God the Father Almighty; Maker of heaven and earth.

sections.label: Article 2
paragraphs: And in Jesus Christ his only Son our Lord; who was conceived by the Holy Ghost, born of the Virgin Mary;

sections.label: Article 3
paragraphs: suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, dead, and buried; he descended into hell;

sections.label: Article 4
paragraphs: the third day he rose from the dead;

sections.label: Article 5
paragraphs: he ascended into heaven; and sitteth at the right hand of God the Father Almighty;

sections.label: Article 6
paragraphs: from thence he shall come to judge the quick and the dead.

sections.label: Article 7
paragraphs: I believe in the Holy Ghost;

sections.label: Article 8
paragraphs: the holy catholic Church; the communion of saints;

blurb: The baptismal creed of the Western church, received in this form by the eighth century.
